source_row.rationale: Friction-reducing sheets and other repositioning devices help reduce shear and friction forces on the client's skin (reducing pressure injury risk) and reduce physical strain on staff during the repositioning process, supporting both client skin integrity and staff safety, as part of safe patient handling practices.
source_row.source_detail: Safe-patient-handling principles and assistive devices to reduce patient shear and worker musculoskeletal strain; accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: American Nurses Association — Safe Patient Handling and Mobility
